exposure: false positive newborn screening for VLCAD deficiency
body weight change at newborn screening
outcome: Change in body weight at the sampling day of newborn screening
Body weight gain at the one-month medical checkup
cohort: 17 infants with false positive newborn screening results for VLCAD deficiency and 300 controls
finding: Infants with false positive newborn screening results for VLCAD deficiency had significantly greater weight loss from birth to the time of screening and lower weight gain at one month compared to controls.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in Cesarean section rates between the false positive group (for a metabolic disorder) and the control group.
